title: Literary Devices Explained — Analogy
skills: define analogy as a literary and rhetorical device
identify analogies in literary and informational texts
analyze how analogies clarify complex ideas through comparison
apply analogy effectively in explanatory and persuasive writing
alignment_note: Introduces analogy as a comparison used to explain, clarify, or illuminate relationships between ideas. Supports figurative-language analysis, rhetorical reasoning, close reading, explanatory writing, and author's craft across high school English courses.
